theorems.name: Submission.iwl_localization
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ), SlicingTheorem → (∀ (K : Set (Eucl P)), IsCompact K → ∀ (Tj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)), (∀ j, IsIntegralCurrent (Tj j)) → (∀ j, (Tj j).support ⊆ K) → (⨆ j, ((Tj j).mass + (Tj j).boundary.mass)) < ∞ → WeaklyConvergesOn Tj T → IsIntegerMultiplicity T) → (∀ (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (Tj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), (∀ j, IsIntegralCurrent (Tj j)) → (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → (⨆ j, ((Tj j).massOn W + (Tj j).boundary.massOn W)) < ∞) → WeaklyConvergesOn Tj T → IsIntegerMultiplicity T)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
